from collections import Counter

# Read input string S
S = input().strip()

# Count the frequency of each character in the string
char_count = Counter(S)

# Calculate the number of ordered pairs (i, j) such that S[i] = S[j]
pairs_count = sum(count * (count - 1) // 2 for count in char_count.values())

# Print the result
print(pairs_count)
